text:
maria: Heads-up — competitor shipped a basic routing control for cost-sensitive customers. Sales is getting questions. We should decide whether to ship a lightweight counter quickly or double-down on our deeper differentiators.
kevin: Seen it. It's very narrow (per-request cost tiers + static fallback). Low engineering surface. Could be a quick win for sign-ups.
sam: Sales feedback: small accounts want predictable pricing + a 'low-cost' mode. Enterprise still cares about per-tenant SLAs. If we don't respond, we lose some trials.
anya: From research: their UX is simple but noisy — lots of manual toggles. We can match parity by shipping a guided preset + telemetry that proves improved cost/latency.
maria: Proposal: two-track approach
- quick parity MVP for self-serve (2w spike + 3w build)
- parallel work on 'smart-routing' differentiator (longer runway, ops + ML)
kevin: For the MVP scope I'd suggest:
```
- per-route cost_tier (low/medium/high)
- fallback model variant for low tier
- UI preset + API flag `cost_profile`
- telemetry hook (tokens, latency, cost)
```
sam: That maps to what sales needs. Price it as a toggle in dashboard. We can convert trials into paid with an obvious opt-in.
maria: Risks: parity MVP might cannibalize our premium roadmap. Need guardrails so enterprises still invest in the advanced offering.
kevin: Agreed — implement a soft gate: make advanced routing (auto-batching, KV-aware caching) only available on Dedicated and Private.
anya: We should add an eval checklist for quality regressions when falling back to low-cost variants.
devex-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/roadmap/1764202020-costmode-mvp — check edits and add acceptance criteria
sam: Quick asks from GTM: sample messaging, pricing blurb, and a demo gif. Can we have a content sprint after MVP alpha?
maria: Yes — timeline: MVP alpha in 5w from greenlight, demo sprint in week 6. Canary to 10% of new trials first.
kevin: Resource ask: 1 eng (frontend), 1 eng (runtime), 0.5 SRE, 0.5 infra. I can allocate if we greenlight.
anya: I'll own the eval prompts and the telemetry dashboard spec.
maria: Decision check — agree to proceed with parity MVP + parallel differentiator R&D? React with :+1: or :minus:
sam: :+1:
kevin: :+1:
anya: :+1:
maria: Great — I'll spin up the PRD and tag folks. Action: kevin to open runtime spike ticket, anya to draft eval set, sam to align GTM messaging.
